text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa! What's with this huge downpour?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wow, it's basically flooding! I can't even see the track! If this keeps up, today's training is gonna be…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh NOOO! And today I was thinking of running with Taishin too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What? I don't remember you asking me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Can't you make the clouds go away?
choice_data_list: That's… out of my pay grade.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But at this rate, I can't run with Taishiiin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Like I said, you never—ugh, whatever…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Besides, no one can change the weather. It's never gonna happen.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Really? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ticket looks over my way with hope in her eyes.
choice_data_list: We could make some sunshine dolls to pray for sunny weather.
Let's wait and see what happens.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's a great idea! Taishin, come join us!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sunshine dolls? What are you, a little kid? I'm not doing that.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Why not? It's fun! At least watch me make one!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh, come on…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Let's see. We'll need a white handkerchief and something to fill it up with… Trainer, do you have stuff in your office? Let's go look!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Look at this, Trainer! I made so many sunshine dolls!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A whole pile of them is sitting on my desk.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I figured if I'm putting up one, I might as well make a whole bunch. Maybe it'll work faster that way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, the sight of all those dolls in one place is kinda creeping me out…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: How did you not get sick of making them?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Get sick of it? As long as I've got materials, I could make them forever!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Good idea, me! I'm gonna keep making more until it's sunny!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, a ray of sunlight shines in through the window, as bright and clear as if there was never a cloud in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOW! It got sunny! All the sunshine dolls I made really worked!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You're giving them credit for this? You didn't even hang them up yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looking around at the huge pile of dolls, I can't help but feel like Winning Ticket's perseverance truly did save the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A little while later…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! It stopped! The rain is GONE!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But the track's still a muddy mess. I don't think we're out of the woods just yet—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go do some light jogging!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, she's not listening to a word I say.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishiiin! Trainer! I'm back!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It's still pretty muddy, but if you think of it as a soft dirt track, it's nothing I can't handle!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It could actually work as great training for controlling our balance while running!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah? You think so too? Okay, Taishin, that settles it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Go get changed so we can run!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: How many times do I have to say this? I never said I'd run with you today!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? No way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yes way!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: For real?! THIS IS HORRIBLE!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uerghhh! I was really looking forward to it too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I really wanted… sniff… to run together…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Gah! You're so annoying! Stop crying!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… Then… will you join me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Why would I—ugh, turning you down is just getting exhausting at this point.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm still not joining you today, but… let's do it sometime soon, okay?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Really?! Yaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yay, yay, yay! It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right! I gotta get faster before we run then!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …You're such a dummy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Narita Taishin and I continue watching Ticket train.
